name: code-crew
description: Famous-programmer code review crew (Knuth + Hickey + Torvalds), with diff-grounded verifier and the full extended-lens persona briefs bundled.

interface.shortDescription: Multi-lens PR review: K+H+T blind passes → diff-grounded verifier → synthesis.
interface.longDescription: Code Crew packages famous-programmer reasoning archetypes for code review, design critique, and refactoring decisions. The default Knuth + Hickey + Torvalds crew was the best-tested triple in this repo's SWE-PRBench experiments (n=50). Bundled persona briefs and a mandatory diff-grounded verifier procedure ship inside the skill.
defaultPrompt: Use Code Crew to review the current diff.
Use Code Crew, Torvalds only, to decide whether this patch should land.
Use Code Crew to critique this design: incidental vs essential complexity?
